about.intro: Hi, I'm Ahmet Kula. I like building digital products and interactive experiences where technology, design and creativity meet. To me, good software isn't just code that works; it's an experience that is considered, fast and valuable to the people using it.

points.label: Think.
points.text: I start by understanding the problem and the people living with it.

points.label: Design.
points.text: Structure, rhythm and motion are considered together from the start.

points.label: Build.
points.text: I deliver fast, accessible and easy to maintain.
